name: Dread/Anxiety Accumulation Circuit
short_description: Accumulates threat evidence while discounting available safety cues, weighted by prior threat beliefs, to generate anxiety levels and avoidance threshold signals.

components.name: THREAT_EVIDENCE_ACCUM
components.description: Integrates evidence for threat at rate determined by perceptual salience and prior beliefs

components.name: SAFETY_CUE_DISCOUNTER
components.description: Reduces threat accumulation based on detected safety cues and reassurance availability

components.name: PRIOR_BELIEF_INTEGRATOR
components.description: Modulates threat accumulation rate based on learned prior threat expectations

components.name: AVOIDANCE_THRESHOLD_MONITOR
components.description: Detects when anxiety crosses threshold to trigger avoidance behavior

scope_conditions: Potential or perceived threat in environment
key_references: Grupe, D. W., & Nitschke, J. B. (2013). Uncertainty and anticipation in anxiety: An integrated neurobiological and psychological perspective. Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 14(7), 488–501.
Mobbs, D., Headley, D. B., Ding, Y., & Dayan, P. (2015). Space odyssey: Alexander Borovsky's enduring legacy on the study of anxiety. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 19(12), 732–745.
design_implications: Anxiety-prone individuals underweight safety cues; design threat-vulnerable spaces with visible, explicit safety information (e.g., emergency exits, personnel, communication devices)
Repeated safe exposure reduces threat accumulation; create graduated exposure opportunities in potentially threatening environments to build safety confidence
